decisions.why: Not re-opened in this round; D15 and T14-T15 are the delta under review.

decisions.summary: bundle numbers the non-intro blocks; verdict ends with [§n,...] or [§] when silent; rows keep rests and pages; page snapshots in dev/claims-pages.json
decisions.why: FR-016's numbered blocks, per-row block digests and per-page digests. Excluding intro blocks follows the existing research fingerprint (an intro edit already owed nothing).

decisions.summary: owed: rests changed (full) / triage / research changed (full, no snapshots); push refuses triage-owed claims until recorded
decisions.why: FR-016's owed rule; refusing the push on an unrecorded triage enforces the requested triage.

decisions.summary: the triage shows only NEW or CHANGED blocks; a REMOVED block is never shown - 'a claim resting on it is rests changed'
decisions.why: FR-016 says the triage checks 'the new, changed and removed blocks'. The stated justification holds only for rows that recorded rests; D15.4 itself leaves every backfilled row (today's whole index) without rests, and an untagged verdict also records none. For those rows a deletion of the very block a claim rests on yields an empty triage page and the claim is CLEARED unseen (record_triage clears every unit not named; test_a_page_moved_only_by_a_removal_needs_no_triage_block asserts the empty bundle). The same holds for a rests-bearing claim whose unnamed caveat or exception is deleted. This defeats the amendment's purpose ('ensure the rechecks are appropriately scoped' - a change that bears on a claim must still reach it). Fix: list removed blocks (the snapshot digests no longer standing, with their words from the store or the base page) in the triage bundle, and add a test that a removal on a no-rests row reaches the triage.

decisions.summary: one ad-hoc opus agent replies TOUCHES lines; named claims owed impl-drift, the rest recorded cleared at today's pages
decisions.why: FR-016: one cheap check naming the claims a change could bear on; those to impl-drift, the rest cleared without a re-judge.

decisions.summary: backfill once: rows whose research fingerprint matches today's get pages and snapshots; a moved row stays owed in full; no-rests rows triaged on next change
decisions.why: FR-016's backfill clause, word for word.

decisions.summary: 0081 follow-ups (four figures as deviations, two wording points) then claims-triage and impl-drift on what it sends on
decisions.why: Amendment 4: the fix lands before the rechecks so they are scoped; FR-008 has the page state what the maps do, each value in its class.
